svg.title: The primary-school gap between gross and net rates narrowed in some groups and widened in others in 2000–2017
svg.desc: Slope chart: The primary-school gap between gross and net rates narrowed in some groups and widened in others in 2000–2017: in 2000: World: 15.7, Türkiye: 9.4, European Union: 6.3, North America: 5.2, Latin America and Caribbean: 21.5, Least developed countries: 16.4, South Asia: 23.2; in 2017: World: 12.5, Türkiye: 9.6, European Union: 4.6, North America: 6.4, Latin America and Caribbean: 13.4, Least developed countries: 20.0, South Asia: 29.4.
